model.title: Freedom of Association in Higher Education Act of 2026
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Erin Houchin (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would protect college students' right to form and join single-sex social organizations at universities that receive federal student aid. It would prohibit these institutions from punishing students or organizations for limiting membership based on sex, from forcing members to give up these protections, or from imposing recruitment restrictions on single-sex groups unless both the group and school agree to it in writing.
